item.title: What's New in Audit 10.3.0
item.description: Audit 10.3.0 Multi-tenant audit records AccessLog and DataAudit now carry a TenantId, and AuditDbContext inherits Juice’s MultiTenantDbContext. Both entities are configured as IsMultiTenant(SharingType.Global): A tenant reads and writes only its own audit records. The root context (no tenant resolved: the gRPC audit server, an admin view, or a non multi-tenant app) reads and writes the records of all tenants.
